cumleler: How much can the usable range of hearing shrink with hearing loss?
The range between threshold and uncomfortable loudness is the dynamic range.
Normal hearing: SRT five, discomfort level one hundred, range ninety-five.
With cochlear loss, the SRT may be sixty, discomfort still one hundred.
Then the range is only forty decibels.
Fitting everyday sounds into it is a major hearing aid challenge.
